content.title: Strategic Result: Physical and Technology Systems
content.summary: The City Council has established strategic goals aimed at enhancing physical and technology systems to improve connectivity and service delivery by 2030. Key objectives include modernizing technology and infrastructure, improving accessibility to services, ensuring safety and security of systems, and addressing funding gaps. Progress on these goals will be monitored quarterly, with updates starting in October 2024.
content.body:
Below are the City Council's Strategic Goals related to Physical and Technology Systems to be achieved between now and 2030. As of July 1, 2024, the City Team has begun monitoring these internal goals. Over the next quarter, progress on these internal actions and goals will be measured to support the achievement of the City Council's strategic direction. The first progress update will be provided here in October, with subsequent updates occurring quarterly. You will soon be able to access detailed information about the internal goals, actions, and measures being monitored and reported on by the City Team to ensure the implementation of the City Council’s strategic vision. [View the City Council Strategic Plan](/DocumentCenter/View/4218/COA-Council-Strat-Plan-2024-ADA---facing-pages-1)

**![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4200)Strategic Result:** Improve City and community connectivity by providing reliable and accessible physical and technology systems.

---

## Strategic Goal 1

Identify and prioritize projects for modernizing our technology systems to provide effective service delivery.

## Strategic Goal 2

Identify and prioritize projects for modernizing our physical infrastructure to maintain and elevate service levels.

## Strategic Goal 3

Improve internal and external accessibility to information, programs, systems, and services.

## Strategic Goal 4

Ensure all physical and technology assets support reliable safety response, emergency preparedness, and City and community resilience.

## Strategic Goal 5

Ensure the security of the physical and technology systems while also investigating and holding accountable those who put our systems at risk.

## Strategic Goal 6

Close infrastructure deficit and funding gaps.
